profile.facility_type_note: Part of Digital Realty's Silicon Valley (Santa Clara/San Jose area) data center campus, one of the company's largest US clusters. Two facilities in this group carry independent historic significance: 360 Spear Street and 365 Main Street in San Francisco are separate, well known carrier hotel buildings; 365 Main Street was the site of a widely covered July 2007 power outage that took down major web services including Craigslist and other sites hosted there, later becoming a Digital Realty/Digital Realty-heritage asset. SJC10 is documented at 1100 Space Park Drive per Digital Realty's own site.

reading.body:
Digital Realty's SJC10 facility in Santa Clara totals 163,500 square feet with N+1 cooling redundancy, but the operator has not published a megawatt capacity figure for this building. Without a power specification, the facility's ability to support AI workloads cannot be assessed from published data.

SJC10 is one of 103 mapped data center facilities in California, a state with 365 megawatts of published capacity spread across 11 facilities that disclose their power figures. This facility does not appear among the state's ranked published capacities.

Digital Realty operates multiple properties in the Silicon Valley cluster including legacy carrier hotels in San Francisco, but SJC10's contribution to the operator's total buildout and grid impact in the region remains unquantified in public specifications.
